duplicate-detachment: You cannot select the same detachment more than once.
constraints: Note that some detachment rules list units and other detachments that your army either must include or cannot include; you must follow all such rules when building your army for the detachments you have selected.
unit-admission: You can only select units with your faction keyword and units available to your army faction.
support-attachment: For each leader and support unit in your roster, you can attach them to a bodyguard unit that they can join, following the rules for Forming Attached Units (19.01). Each support unit in your roster must be attached to a bodyguard unit.
